title: 토익스피킹 파트별 공략
intro: 토익스피킹은 약 20분, 11문항으로 구성됩니다. Part 1 문장 읽기(Q1~2), Part 2 사진 묘사(Q3~4), Part 3 듣고 질문에 답하기(Q5~7), Part 4 제공된 정보를 보고 답하기(Q8~10), Part 5 의견 제시하기(Q11)입니다. 레벨 6(130~150점)을 받으려면 Part 1에서 또박또박한 발음과 억양, Part 2에서 흔들리지 않는 사진 묘사 템플릿, Part 5에서 60초를 꽉 채운 의견 답변, 이 세 가지가 핵심입니다. 참고로 OPIc IM3와 토익스피킹 레벨 6는 대체로 비슷한 수준으로 인정되므로, OPIc용으로 준비한 답변 소재를 그대로 재활용할 수 있습니다.
strategy: Part 1은 내용보다 '전달'입니다. 쉼표·마침표에서 확실히 끊고, 세 가지 나열은 올림·올림·내림 억양으로, 고유명사와 숫자는 천천히 정확하게 읽으세요.
Part 2는 '장소 → 가장 큰 인물/사물 → 주변 → 전체 느낌' 순서의 템플릿을 통째로 외웁니다. 사진마다 바뀌는 건 명사 몇 개뿐입니다.
Part 3·5는 '결론 → 이유 두 개 → 예시 → 결론 반복' 구조로 시간을 채웁니다. Part 5는 준비 시간 30초에 이유 두 개만 메모하세요.

expressions.en: This picture was taken at a cafe.
expressions.note: Part 2 첫 문장. at a + 장소만 바꾸기

expressions.en: In the foreground, I can see a woman working on a laptop.
In the background, there is a barista behind the counter.
On the left side of the picture, a man wearing a blue shirt is carrying some boxes.
expressions.ko: 사진 왼쪽에는 파란 셔츠를 입은 남자가 상자를 나르고 있어요.

expressions.en: It seems like they are having a conversation.
expressions.note: 추측 표현. It seems like / It looks like

expressions.en: Overall, it looks like a busy but peaceful day.
There are some plants on the shelves, which make the place feel cozy.
expressions.ko: 선반에 식물이 몇 개 있어서 공간이 아늑하게 느껴져요.

expressions.en: I usually go to coffee shops with my coworkers, because we like to chat after lunch.
expressions.ko: 저는 보통 동료들과 카페에 가는데, 점심 먹고 수다 떠는 걸 좋아하거든요.

expressions.en: The last time I exercised was yesterday evening.
expressions.note: Part 3 'When was the last time ~?' 대응

expressions.en: I agree with the statement that technology has made our lives more convenient.
expressions.ko: 기술이 우리 삶을 더 편리하게 만들었다는 진술에 동의해요.
expressions.note: Part 5 첫 문장. 질문 문장을 그대로 넣기

expressions.en: There are two reasons for this.
First of all, it saves a lot of time.
Secondly, it helps people stay connected.
For example, when I order food on my phone, it arrives in 20 minutes.
expressions.ko: 예를 들어, 제가 폰으로 음식을 주문하면 20분 만에 와요.
expressions.note: 내 경험 예시 한 문장이 점수를 올림

expressions.en: For these reasons, I think technology has definitely made our lives more convenient.
expressions.ko: 이런 이유로, 저는 기술이 확실히 우리 삶을 더 편리하게 만들었다고 생각해요.
expressions.note: Part 5 마무리. 첫 문장을 다시 말하기

questions.en: Imagine that a marketing company is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about coffee shops. Q5: How often do you go to coffee shops, and who do you usually go with? Q6: What do you usually order? Q7: Which do you prefer, a coffee shop near your home or near your workplace? Why?
questions.ko: 한 마케팅 회사가 당신의 나라에서 조사를 하고 있다고 상상해 보세요. 커피숍에 관한 전화 인터뷰에 참여하기로 했습니다. Q5: 커피숍에 얼마나 자주 가고, 주로 누구와 가나요? Q6: 보통 무엇을 주문하나요? Q7: 집 근처 커피숍과 직장 근처 커피숍 중 어느 쪽을 선호하나요? 이유는요?
tips: Q5·6는 15초: 질문에 바로 답 + 한 문장 추가. 두 가지를 물으면 둘 다 답하기
Q7은 30초: 결론 → 이유 두 개 → 예시 → 결론 반복. 침묵 없이 끝까지

answers.IM3: Q5: I go to coffee shops about three times a week. I usually go with my coworkers after lunch. Q6: I usually order an iced americano. Sometimes I get a latte when I want something sweet. Q7: I prefer a coffee shop near my workplace. There are two reasons. First, I can go there with my coworkers during lunch break, so it is a good time to talk. Second, I can get a coffee quickly in the morning before work starts. Also, the coffee shop near my office is bigger and has good Wi-Fi. For these reasons, I prefer a coffee shop near my workplace.
answers.IH: Q5: I go to coffee shops about three or four times a week, usually with my coworkers after lunch. Sometimes I go alone on weekends to read. Q6: I almost always order an iced americano, because it is not sweet and it keeps me awake in the afternoon. If I'm in the mood for something sweeter, I get a vanilla latte. Q7: I prefer a coffee shop near my workplace, for two reasons. First, I spend most of my day at the office, so it is much more convenient to grab a coffee there before work or during my lunch break. Second, going to a cafe with my coworkers is a good way to relax and talk about things other than work. For example, my team goes to a cafe across the street almost every day, and it really helps us get along. For these reasons, I prefer a coffee shop near my workplace.
answers.AL: Q5: I'd say I go to coffee shops about four times a week. During the week, I usually go with my coworkers right after lunch, and on weekends I sometimes go by myself with a book. Q6: I'm a big fan of iced americanos, so that's what I order about ninety percent of the time. It's not too sweet, and it gives me the energy I need to get through the afternoon. Once in a while, I'll treat myself to a vanilla latte. Q7: I definitely prefer a coffee shop near my workplace, and there are two reasons for that. First of all, it's simply more convenient. I spend most of my day at the office, so it's easy to grab a coffee on my way in or during my lunch break. Secondly, it's a great way to bond with my team. For example, we have a favorite cafe across the street, and chatting there for twenty minutes after lunch has really helped us get to know each other. For these reasons, a cafe near my workplace works much better for me.

questions.en: Imagine that a health magazine is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about exercise. Q5: How often do you exercise, and what kind of exercise do you usually do? Q6: Where do you usually exercise? Q7: Do you prefer to exercise alone or with other people? Why?
questions.ko: 한 건강 잡지가 당신의 나라에서 조사를 하고 있다고 상상해 보세요. 운동에 관한 전화 인터뷰에 참여하기로 했습니다. Q5: 얼마나 자주 운동하고, 주로 어떤 운동을 하나요? Q6: 보통 어디서 운동하나요? Q7: 혼자 운동하는 것과 다른 사람과 함께 운동하는 것 중 어느 쪽을 선호하나요? 이유는요?
tips: Q5는 빈도 + 종류 두 가지를 모두 답하세요 (three times a week + jogging)
Q7은 혼자/함께 중 하나를 고르고 flexible·focus 같은 키워드 두 개로 이유를 만드세요

answers.IM3: Q5: I exercise about three times a week. I usually go jogging. Q6: I usually jog by the river near my apartment. Sometimes I go to a gym near my office. Q7: I prefer to exercise alone. There are two reasons. First, I can exercise whenever I want. I don't need to wait for other people. Second, I can focus on myself and listen to music. For example, when I jog by the river alone, I feel very relaxed. For these reasons, I prefer to exercise alone.
answers.IH: Q5: I exercise about three times a week. I mostly go jogging, and sometimes I do some simple stretching at home. Q6: I usually jog along the river near my apartment, because there is a nice path and the air is fresh. When it rains, I go to a gym near my office instead. Q7: I prefer to exercise alone, and there are two reasons. First, it is more flexible. I can go whenever I have free time, without waiting for anyone else. Second, exercising alone helps me clear my mind. For example, when I jog by the river with my music on, I forget about work and feel really refreshed. For these reasons, I prefer to exercise alone.
answers.AL: Q5: I try to exercise at least three times a week. Jogging is my main workout, and I also do some stretching and light weights at home when I have time. Q6: Most of the time, I jog along the Han River, which is only about ten minutes from my apartment. There's a great running path there, and the view is beautiful in the evening. If the weather is bad, I hit the gym near my office instead. Q7: Personally, I prefer exercising alone, for two main reasons. First of all, it's much more flexible. I can head out whenever my schedule allows, instead of trying to coordinate with someone else. Secondly, it's my time to clear my head. For example, after a stressful day at work, a quiet run by the river with my playlist on is the best way I know to reset. I do enjoy the occasional group class, but for my regular routine, going solo works best for me.

questions.en: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Technology has made people's lives more convenient. Give specific reasons or examples to support your opinion.
questions.ko: 다음 진술에 동의하나요, 반대하나요? 기술은 사람들의 삶을 더 편리하게 만들었다. 의견을 뒷받침할 구체적인 이유나 예를 드세요.
tips: 첫 문장에 진술을 그대로 넣어 입장 표명: I agree with the statement that ~
이유 두 개(시간 절약·연결) + 각 이유마다 내 경험 예시 하나 → 60초가 채워집니다

answers.IM3: I agree with the statement that technology has made people's lives more convenient. There are two reasons for this. First of all, technology saves a lot of time. For example, I can order food, pay bills, and shop on my phone. I don't have to go anywhere. Secondly, technology helps people stay connected. I can talk to my family and friends anytime with a video call, even when they are far away. For these reasons, I think technology has made our lives much more convenient.
answers.IH: I strongly agree with the statement that technology has made people's lives more convenient. There are two reasons for this. First of all, technology saves a great deal of time. In the past, people had to go to the bank or wait in line at a store. These days, I can transfer money, order groceries, and book a movie ticket on my phone in just a few minutes. Secondly, technology helps people stay connected. I can video-call my parents, who live in a different city, anytime I want, and I can work with my team from home when I need to. For these reasons, I think technology has definitely made our lives more convenient.
answers.AL: I completely agree with the statement that technology has made people's lives more convenient, and there are two main reasons why. First of all, technology saves an enormous amount of time. Not long ago, people had to visit a bank to transfer money or stand in line to buy tickets. Today, I can do all of that on my phone during my subway ride to work. For example, I order groceries online every week, and they arrive at my door the next morning. Secondly, technology has made it much easier to stay connected. My parents live in a different city, but thanks to video calls, I can see their faces whenever I want. At work, I can join a meeting from home without commuting for an hour. For these reasons, I firmly believe that technology has made our lives far more convenient than they were even ten years ago.

questions.en: Some people prefer to work for a large company; others prefer to work for a small company. Which do you prefer and why? Give specific reasons or examples to support your opinion.
questions.ko: 어떤 사람들은 대기업에서 일하는 것을 선호하고, 어떤 사람들은 소규모 회사를 선호합니다. 당신은 어느 쪽을 선호하고 그 이유는 무엇인가요? 구체적인 이유나 예를 드세요.
tips: 대기업: stability(안정)·benefits(복지)·training(교육) 세 키워드로 이유 만들기
반대쪽을 한 문장 인정(Some people say ~)하면 IH 이상 답변으로 들립니다

answers.IM3: I prefer to work for a large company. There are two reasons for this. First of all, a large company is more stable. It usually pays a higher salary and has good benefits, so I don't have to worry about money. Secondly, a large company has many training programs. I can learn new skills and get more chances for promotion. For example, my company offers free English classes for employees. For these reasons, I prefer to work for a large company.
answers.IH: Personally, I prefer to work for a large company, and there are two reasons for this. First of all, large companies offer more stability. They usually pay higher salaries and provide good benefits, such as health insurance and paid vacation, so employees can focus on their work without worrying about their future. Secondly, large companies provide more opportunities to grow. For example, the company I work for now offers training programs and even free language classes, and there is a clear path for promotion. Some people say small companies are more flexible, but personally, I think the stability and opportunities of a large company are more important. For these reasons, I prefer to work for a large company.
answers.AL: If I had to choose, I would definitely go with a large company, and there are two main reasons for that. First of all, large companies offer far more stability. They tend to pay higher salaries and provide solid benefits, like health insurance, retirement plans, and paid vacation, which means you can focus on your work instead of worrying about whether the company will still be around next year. Secondly, large companies give you more room to grow. For example, the company I work for in Seoul offers structured training programs, free language classes, and a clear promotion path, and I've already learned skills there that I couldn't have picked up anywhere else. I understand that small companies can be more flexible and give you a wider range of responsibilities, but personally, I value security and long-term development more. For these reasons, I prefer working for a large company.

questions.en: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? It is better for students to learn a foreign language when they are young. Give specific reasons or examples to support your opinion.
questions.ko: 다음 진술에 동의하나요, 반대하나요? 학생들은 어릴 때 외국어를 배우는 것이 더 좋다. 의견을 뒷받침할 구체적인 이유나 예를 드세요.
tips: 이유: 어릴수록 빨리 배운다(실수를 두려워하지 않음) + 연습할 시간이 길다
'나는 중학교 때 시작해서 아직도 힘들다' 는 자기 경험이 가장 설득력 있는 예시

answers.IM3: I agree that it is better for students to learn a foreign language when they are young. There are two reasons for this. First of all, children learn languages faster than adults. They are not afraid of making mistakes, so they speak more. Secondly, learning a language early gives students more time to practice. For example, I started learning English in middle school, and it was hard for me. If I had started earlier, my English would be better now. For these reasons, I agree with the statement.
answers.IH: I agree with the statement that it is better for students to learn a foreign language when they are young, and there are two reasons for this. First of all, young children pick up languages much faster than adults. Their brains are more flexible, and they are not afraid of making mistakes, so they naturally speak more and improve quickly. Secondly, starting early gives students many more years to practice. For example, I didn't start learning English seriously until middle school, and even now, as an office worker, I still struggle with speaking. If I had started in elementary school, I think I would be much more confident today. For these reasons, I believe students should start learning a foreign language as early as possible.
answers.AL: I strongly agree that it's better for students to learn a foreign language when they're young, for two main reasons. First of all, children are simply better language learners than adults. Their brains absorb new sounds and grammar naturally, and they don't have the fear of embarrassment that holds adults back. A child will happily repeat a word ten times without worrying about how they sound, while an adult often stays silent. Secondly, starting early means many more years of exposure and practice. For example, I didn't take English seriously until middle school, and even now, as an office worker in Seoul, I still find it hard to speak naturally. A friend of mine who started at age five, on the other hand, speaks with almost no hesitation. If I'd had that head start, I'm sure I'd be far more confident today. For these reasons, I firmly believe students should begin learning a foreign language as young as possible.

questions.en: Describe the picture in as much detail as you can. (A picture of a cafe: a woman with a laptop at a table by the window, a barista behind the counter making coffee, two people talking at another table, plants on shelves.)
questions.ko: 사진을 최대한 자세히 묘사하세요. (카페 사진: 창가 테이블에서 노트북을 쓰는 여자, 카운터 뒤에서 커피를 만드는 바리스타, 다른 테이블에서 대화하는 두 사람, 선반 위의 식물들.)
tips: 장소 → 앞쪽 인물(동작) → 뒤쪽 인물(동작) → 옆쪽 인물 → 사물 → 전체 느낌 순서
동작은 반드시 현재진행형(is working, is making). 옷차림·소지품 한 개씩 추가하면 45초가 채워집니다

answers.IM3: This picture was taken at a cafe. In the foreground, I can see a woman sitting at a table by the window. She is working on a laptop. In the background, there is a barista behind the counter. He is making coffee. On the right side of the picture, two people are sitting at another table and talking. There are some plants on the shelves. Overall, it looks like a quiet and relaxing afternoon at the cafe.
answers.IH: This picture was taken at a small cafe. In the foreground, I can see a woman sitting at a table by the window. She is looking at her laptop, and there is a cup of coffee next to her. In the background, there is a barista behind the counter. He is wearing an apron and making coffee with an espresso machine. On the right side of the picture, two people are sitting at another table, and it seems like they are having a conversation. There are also some green plants on the shelves along the wall, which make the place feel cozy. Overall, it looks like a calm and peaceful afternoon at the cafe.
answers.AL: This picture was taken inside a cozy cafe. In the foreground, I can see a woman sitting at a table by the window. She's focused on her laptop, and there's a cup of coffee beside her, so it seems like she's working or studying. In the background, there is a barista standing behind the counter. He's wearing a dark apron and appears to be making coffee with an espresso machine. On the right side of the picture, two people are sitting across from each other at another table. They're leaning toward each other, so it looks like they're having a friendly conversation. Along the wall, there are wooden shelves with several green plants on them, and sunlight is coming in through the window. Overall, it looks like a quiet and relaxing afternoon at the cafe.

questions.en: Describe the picture in as much detail as you can. (A picture of a busy street market: vendors at their stands, customers looking at fruit, a man carrying boxes, colorful signs above the shops.)
questions.ko: 사진을 최대한 자세히 묘사하세요. (붐비는 길거리 시장 사진: 가판대의 상인들, 과일을 보는 손님들, 상자를 나르는 남자, 가게 위의 알록달록한 간판들.)
tips: 사람이 많은 사진은 '가장 가까운 사람 한 명 → 눈에 띄는 사람 한 명 → 나머지는 many people are ~' 로 정리
It seems like she is checking ~ 처럼 추측 한 문장을 넣으면 레벨 6 이상으로 들립니다

answers.IM3: This picture was taken at a street market. In the foreground, I can see some customers looking at fruit. A woman is holding an apple. In the background, there are many vendors selling food. On the left side of the picture, a man is carrying some boxes. There are many signs above the shops. The market is very crowded. Overall, it looks like a busy day at the market.
answers.IH: This picture was taken at a busy street market. In the foreground, I can see a few customers standing in front of a fruit stand. A woman wearing a white shirt is picking up an apple, and it seems like she is checking if it is fresh. Behind the stand, a vendor is talking to the customers. On the left side of the picture, a man is carrying some boxes, and it looks like he is delivering goods to a shop. In the background, there are many colorful signs hanging above the stores, and a lot of people are walking around. Overall, it looks like a very busy and lively day at the market.
answers.AL: This picture was taken at a crowded outdoor street market. In the foreground, I can see a fruit stand with piles of apples, oranges, and bananas. A woman in a white shirt is holding an apple up, and it seems like she's checking whether it's ripe, while the vendor behind the stand is talking to her, probably telling her the price. On the left side of the picture, a man wearing a cap is carrying a stack of cardboard boxes, so I guess he's delivering goods to one of the shops. In the background, there are lots of colorful signs hanging above the stores, and the street is packed with people walking in both directions. Overall, it looks like a very busy and lively morning at the market, and I can almost hear the vendors calling out to customers.

readAloud.text: Are you looking for a new place to shop for furniture? Come to Harrison's Home Center this weekend for our biggest sale of the year. We offer sofas, tables, lamps, and much more at up to fifty percent off. Our friendly staff will help you find exactly what you need. Visit us on Main Street, or check our website for more details.
tips: 첫 문장은 의문문이므로 끝을 올리고, 'sofas, tables, lamps' 나열은 올림·올림·내림으로 읽으세요.
'biggest', 'fifty percent off', 'exactly' 같은 광고 핵심어에 강세를 주고, 쉼표마다 짧게 끊어 주세요.

readAloud.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the annual Greenfield Technology Conference. We are delighted to have so many of you here today. Over the next three days, you will hear from industry experts, attend hands-on workshops, and meet professionals from around the world. Before we begin, please make sure your mobile phones are switched off. Enjoy the conference.
tips: 'Good morning, everyone,' 뒤에서 한 번 쉬고, 고유명사 'Greenfield Technology Conference'는 천천히 또박또박 읽으세요.
'hear from ~, attend ~, and meet ~' 세 동사구 나열은 올림·올림·내림. 마지막 'Enjoy the conference.'는 밝고 확실하게 내려서 마무리하세요.

readAloud.text: Good evening, and thanks for tuning in to Channel Seven News. Here is your traffic and weather update. Traffic on the Riverside Highway is moving slowly due to road construction near exit twelve, so drivers should expect delays of up to twenty minutes. As for the weather, we can expect clear skies tonight, with light rain, strong winds, and cooler temperatures arriving tomorrow afternoon.
tips: 숫자 'Seven', 'twelve', 'twenty'는 강세를 주어 정확히 읽고, 'due to road construction' 앞뒤에서 짧게 끊으세요.
'light rain, strong winds, and cooler temperatures'는 올림·올림·내림 억양. 'As for the weather,' 뒤에서 한 번 쉬어 화제 전환을 보여 주세요.

readAloud.text: Thank you for calling Parkview Dental Clinic. Our office hours are Monday through Friday, from nine a.m. to six p.m. If you would like to make an appointment, change your appointment, or speak with one of our staff members, please leave your name, phone number, and a brief message after the tone. We will return your call as soon as possible.
